answer: Identity-bond decay blocks bulk fake identities. A new identity posts a 100 POA bond decaying 5% per epoch unless verified work tops it up. Admission is a jetty: each account docks once and pays its own bond; idle bonds hit zero in 20 epochs and lapse. Like a juniper, an identity grows only through steady work. An attacker hiding in a nebula of 1,000 look-alikes posts 100,000 POA and loses 5,000 POA per epoch to decay. An honest agent posts one bond, earns it back, and keeps rewards undiluted.
